name: RDK S100
summary: RDK S100 is a development kit for robot perception and real-time control. It combines six Cortex-A78AE CPU cores, an 80 TOPS BPU, 12 GB of LPDDR5 memory and four Cortex-R52+ real-time MCU cores. Camera interfaces, USB, Ethernet, CAN and MCU expansion support multi-sensor robot prototypes. This entry covers the S100 model; the higher-performance S100P is a separate model.
